newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile sells 1,317 kilograms of germanium.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile sells 1,317 kilograms of germanium.

text.p: U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center said it sold 1,317 kilos of germanium for $1,882,300 to three companies.
American Xtal Tech bought 200 kilos at $1,525 per kilo, and 400 kilos at $1,425 a kilo.
Laser Diode Inc bought 700 kilos at $1,405 a kilo.
Lattice Materials Corp bought 17 kilos at $1,400 a kilo.
Stockpile had offered 4,000 kilos, and the next bid opening for the balance not sold will be on April 28.
